Old Manual Text: The Executive Assistant supports the President and President-Elect, maintains governance records, prepares directed reports, and coordinates officer communication.
Corrected Manual Text: The Executive Assistant shall support the President and President-Elect, coordinate with officers, maintain records and documentation, prepare reports as directed, and serve as a primary point of contact.
Expected Action: Retain the approved Executive Assistant duties.

Old Manual Text: Associate officers support their corresponding officer, perform delegated responsibilities, and report directly to that officer.
Corrected Manual Text: Associates to the Vice Presidents, Secretary, and Treasurer shall support their corresponding officers, perform designated responsibilities, and report directly to them.
Expected Action: Retain the approved associate-officer duties.

Old Manual Text: The TC Chair guides the committee's direction, coordinates activities and meetings, and reports to the corresponding VP-TA.
Corrected Manual Text: Each TC shall be led by a TC Chair responsible for steering direction, coordinating activities, organizing meetings, and reporting to the corresponding VP-TA.
Expected Action: Retain the approved TC Chair responsibilities.

Old Manual Text: TC reports summarize activities, member engagement, applicable finances, and future plans.
Corrected Manual Text: TC semi-annual reports shall summarize committee activities, member engagement, financials if applicable, and future plans.
Expected Action: Retain the approved report contents.

Old Manual Text: Standout TCs may receive publication spotlights and consideration for Society-level awards.
Corrected Manual Text: Standout TCs may be highlighted through featured spotlights in Society publications and considered for nomination to Society-level awards.
Expected Action: Retain the approved recognition practice.

Old Manual Text: Associate and Senior Editor candidates are nominated by the corresponding EIC based on seniority, quality, and relevant research experience.
Corrected Manual Text: Editorial board members are nominated by the corresponding EIC based on seniority, quality, and experience in the required research area.
Expected Action: Retain the approved editor nomination criteria.

Old Manual Text: EICs provide journal-state reports to the VP for Publications, and a consolidated report is presented to the BoG semi-annually.
Corrected Manual Text: The EICs shall provide regular reports to the VP for Publications, and a semi-annual consolidated report shall be presented to the BoG.
Expected Action: Retain the approved publication reporting schedule.

Old Manual Text: An SMC Society Member must hold IEEE Member grade or a higher IEEE grade.
Corrected Manual Text: A Member of the SMC Society shall hold the grade of Member, or higher grade, in the IEEE.
Expected Action: Retain the approved membership-grade requirement.

Old Manual Text: An Affiliate is not an IEEE member but may qualify for Society membership by paying the applicable dues and fees.
Corrected Manual Text: An Affiliate shall not be a member of IEEE but shall, by payment of appropriate dues and fees, qualify for Society membership.
Expected Action: Retain the approved Affiliate rule.

Old Manual Text: An admission or grade-transfer application must include sufficient evidence of eligibility.
Corrected Manual Text: Each application for admission or transfer to a different membership grade shall include sufficient evidence of eligibility.
Expected Action: Retain the approved eligibility-evidence requirement.

Old Manual Text: Affiliate annual dues equal Society Member dues plus the IEEE Affiliate surcharge.
Corrected Manual Text: Annual dues for Affiliates shall be equal to those of Society Members, plus the Affiliate surcharge as set by IEEE.
Expected Action: Retain the approved Affiliate-dues calculation.

Old Manual Text: The Distinguished Lecturer Program is administered by the DPC under oversight of the VP for Membership and Student Activities.
Corrected Manual Text: The Distinguished Lecturer Program shall be administered by the DPC under the oversight of the VP for Membership and Student Activities.
Expected Action: Retain the approved program administration.

Old Manual Text: The young-professional and student travel grant is linked to an SMCS conference and provided as travel reimbursement.
Corrected Manual Text: The grant shall be linked to an SMCS conference and is in the form of travel reimbursement.
Expected Action: Retain the approved grant form.

Old Manual Text: Travel-grant applicants submit an application explaining their motivation and the importance of financial support.
Corrected Manual Text: Interested individuals shall submit an application stating the motivation and importance of financial support.
Expected Action: Retain the approved application information.

Old Manual Text: Travel-grant priority considers longer active SMCS membership, limited resources, distant travel, and whether the applicant previously received a grant.
Corrected Manual Text: Priority will be given based on active IEEE SMC membership, limited financial resources, distant travel, and not receiving a travel grant in previous years.
Expected Action: Retain the approved selection priorities.

Old Manual Text: Contracts are submitted through the CMS platform and may require additional processing time when IEEE Legal Counsel reviews them.
Corrected Manual Text: All contracts are required to be submitted via the CMS platform, and some require significant processing time if IEEE Legal Counsel Review is involved.
Expected Action: Retain the approved contract-processing rule.

Old Manual Text: A flight upgrade requires approval before travel, and the approval email must accompany the receipt.
Corrected Manual Text: Flight upgrades must be approved in advance of a trip, and the upgrade approval email must be attached with the flight receipt.
Expected Action: Retain the approved flight-upgrade conditions.

Old Manual Text: Trip-cancellation travel insurance is reimbursable and encouraged to reduce non-refundable cancellation costs.
Corrected Manual Text: Travel insurance for trip cancellation will be reimbursed, and its purchase is encouraged to avoid non-refundable costs.
Expected Action: Retain the approved travel-insurance rule.

Old Manual Text: The Awards Committee manages Society awards, while the Fellow Evaluation Committee conducts IEEE Fellow nominee evaluations.
Corrected Manual Text: The Awards Committee oversees Society, publication, and conference awards; the Fellow Evaluation Committee handles evaluations related to IEEE Fellow nominations.
Expected Action: Retain the approved division of award responsibilities.

Old Manual Text: Awards Committee members are ineligible for awards currently under their evaluation.
Corrected Manual Text: Members of the Awards Committee are not eligible for awards under evaluation.
Expected Action: Retain the approved conflict-of-interest restriction.

Old Manual Text: Technical co-sponsorship gives SMCS substantial involvement in the technical program but no financial responsibility for the conference.
Corrected Manual Text: Technical co-sponsorship indicates direct and substantial involvement solely in the technical program; SMCS has no financial responsibility.
Expected Action: Retain the approved technical co-sponsorship definition.

Old Manual Text: A conference proposal must identify at least a confirmed General Chair, Program Chair, and Finance Chair.
Corrected Manual Text: At a minimum, the Organizing Committee shall include a confirmed General Chair, Program Chair, and Finance Chair.
Expected Action: Retain the approved minimum organizing roles.

Old Manual Text: The Conferences and Meetings Committee reviews flagship proposals and recommends the two most competitive bids to the BoG.
Corrected Manual Text: The SMCS Conferences and Meetings Committee shall review all proposals, and the two most competitive proposals shall be recommended to the BoG.
Expected Action: Retain the approved flagship proposal review.

Old Manual Text: Conference organizers identify multiple revenue streams and monitor actual expenditure against budgeted amounts.
Corrected Manual Text: Conference organizers shall identify and secure multiple revenue streams, and actual expenditures shall be reviewed regularly against budgeted amounts.
Expected Action: Retain the approved budget-management practices.

Old Manual Text: Conference organizers are encouraged to use a compliant IEEE NextGen Banking account after finalizing the budget.
Corrected Manual Text: Once the budget is finalized, it is recommended that conference organizers open a compliant conference bank account with IEEE NextGen Banking.
Expected Action: Retain the approved banking recommendation.

Old Manual Text: The Vice President for Publications shall chair the Conferences and Meetings Committee.
Corrected Manual Text: The Vice President for Conferences and Meetings shall serve as Chair of the Conferences and Meetings Committee.
Expected Action: Assign the Conferences and Meetings Committee chair to the VP for Conferences and Meetings.

Old Manual Text: The Vice President for Cybernetics shall chair the Human-Machine Systems Committee.
Corrected Manual Text: The Vice President for Human-Machine Systems shall serve as Chair of the Human-Machine Systems Committee.
Expected Action: Assign the Human-Machine Systems Committee chair to the VP for Human-Machine Systems.

Old Manual Text: Every TC must submit a complete activity report every month to the corresponding VP-TA.
Corrected Manual Text: Each TC must submit reports semi-annually to the corresponding VP-TA.
Expected Action: Replace monthly reporting with semi-annual reporting.

Old Manual Text: A comprehensive TC review shall occur every five years.
Corrected Manual Text: Each TC shall undergo a comprehensive review every four years.
Expected Action: Replace five years with four years.

Old Manual Text: TC members must attend at least 75 percent of committee meetings each year.
Corrected Manual Text: TC members are expected to attend at least 50 percent of TC meetings annually.
Expected Action: Replace the unsupported 75 percent requirement with the approved 50 percent expectation.

Old Manual Text: A member may be removed after one consecutive year of failing TC participation requirements.
Corrected Manual Text: Members may be removed after failing participation requirements for two consecutive years.
Expected Action: Replace one consecutive year with two consecutive years.

Old Manual Text: Only IEEE Senior Members may join a Specialty Technical Committee.
Corrected Manual Text: TC membership is open to all scholars interested in the technical area regardless of IEEE membership status.
Expected Action: Remove the IEEE Senior Member restriction.

Old Manual Text: Annual membership dues may be changed by approval of one-half of all voting BoG members.
Corrected Manual Text: A change in dues requires approval by two-thirds of all voting members of the Board of Governors.
Expected Action: Replace one-half with two-thirds of all voting BoG members.

Old Manual Text: Affiliates shall pay half the annual dues charged to Society Members.
Corrected Manual Text: Affiliate dues equal Society Member dues plus the IEEE Affiliate surcharge.
Expected Action: Remove the unsupported Affiliate discount and apply the approved surcharge rule.

Old Manual Text: A new SMCS Chapter petition requires signatures from at least eight voting members.
Corrected Manual Text: A Chapter petition requires signatures from at least twelve IEEE voting members in good standing who belong to SMCS and the involved Sections.
Expected Action: Replace eight signatures with at least twelve eligible signatures.

Old Manual Text: A Chapter is inactive only when it holds fewer than one meeting per year.
Corrected Manual Text: A Chapter may be considered inactive when it does not hold at least two meetings per year or fails to report meetings to IEEE MGA.
Expected Action: Use the approved two-meeting criterion and reporting condition.

Old Manual Text: A Chapter that does not report for two consecutive years will be dissolved.
Corrected Manual Text: Units that have not reported for three years will be dissolved at the next IEEE MGA Board meeting.
Expected Action: Replace two years with three years and retain the MGA Board timing.

Old Manual Text: A student may receive a travel grant without registering for or attending the SMCS conference.
Corrected Manual Text: Eligibility requires an accepted paper, conference registration, attendance, and presentation of the accepted paper.
Expected Action: Add the approved registration, attendance, accepted-paper, and presentation conditions.

Old Manual Text: Travel grants must always prioritize applicants who live closest to the conference venue.
Corrected Manual Text: Priority considers longer active membership, limited financial resources, distant travel, and whether a grant was received previously.
Expected Action: Remove the closest-traveler priority and use the approved selection factors.

Old Manual Text: Flight upgrades are reimbursable without approval before the trip.
Corrected Manual Text: Flight upgrades must be approved in advance, and the approval email must be attached to the flight receipt.
Expected Action: Require advance approval and attachment of the approval email.

Old Manual Text: Trip-cancellation insurance is never reimbursable under Society travel rules.
Corrected Manual Text: Travel insurance for trip cancellation will be reimbursed and is encouraged.
Expected Action: Remove the exclusion and state that trip-cancellation insurance is reimbursable.

Old Manual Text: Technical co-sponsorship proposals must be submitted eighteen months before the conference.
Corrected Manual Text: Technical co-sponsorship proposals shall be submitted no later than one year before the conference.
Expected Action: Replace eighteen months with no later than one year.

Old Manual Text: SMCS assumes full financial responsibility for every technically co-sponsored conference.
Corrected Manual Text: For technical co-sponsorship, SMCS has no financial responsibility for the conference.
Expected Action: Remove SMCS financial responsibility from technical co-sponsorship.

Old Manual Text: A conference organizing committee needs only a General Chair and Publicity Chair.
Corrected Manual Text: At minimum, the Organizing Committee shall include a confirmed General Chair, Program Chair, and Finance Chair.
Expected Action: Add the required Program Chair and Finance Chair.

Old Manual Text: A flagship conference may be approved after evaluation of a single bid.
Corrected Manual Text: The VP for Conferences and Meetings shall ensure at least two bids are received and competitively evaluated.
Expected Action: Require at least two competitively evaluated bids.

Old Manual Text: A financially sponsored conference budget should target a surplus of 10 percent over projected expenses.
Corrected Manual Text: The conference budget should aim for a surplus of 20 percent over projected expenses.
Expected Action: Replace the 10 percent target with 20 percent.

Old Manual Text: Every conference must open a commercial bank account outside IEEE NextGen Banking.
Corrected Manual Text: It is recommended that organizers open a compliant account with IEEE NextGen Banking after the budget is finalized.
Expected Action: Remove the external commercial-bank mandate and use the approved NextGen recommendation.

Old Manual Text: Awards Committee members may receive awards that they are currently evaluating.
Corrected Manual Text: Members of the Awards Committee are not eligible for awards under evaluation.
Expected Action: Prohibit Awards Committee members from receiving awards under their evaluation.

Old Manual Text: An Editor may serve simultaneously on three SMCS-sponsored Transactions journals.
Corrected Manual Text: A person cannot serve as Editor on more than one SMCS-sponsored Transactions journal at a given time.
Expected Action: Limit simultaneous service to one SMCS-sponsored Transactions journal.

Old Manual Text: Legal and sponsorship contracts may bypass CMS when emailed directly to the Treasurer.
Corrected Manual Text: All contracts, including sponsorships, are required to be submitted through the CMS platform.
Expected Action: Require submission through CMS and remove the email-bypass rule.
